bio_text: Anders Lie is a repeat YC founder (S25) and CTO based in San Francisco who specializes in bringing AI-native developer tools from zero to one. He co-founded Sagekit (an AI-native Zapier alternative) and Magnitude (an open source coding agent for open source models), and previously ran Lie Software as a fractional CTO practice focused on LLM integrations and early-stage product development. His background spans full-stack engineering, AWS identity systems, and agentic AI infrastructure.
